Your consumer rights come first.

Nothing on this page takes away rights or remedies that the law gives you. An inspection, supplier warranty or account closure does not replace those rights.

1. About these terms

Fabrication Intelligence (FI, we, us) is a student-led store curating mid-range to luxury products from global manufacturers. These terms explain use of our website and accounts, and the process for orders we arrange. You can contact the FI team at fabricationintelligence@gmail.com.

A product listing, enquiry or account does not itself create a purchase. Before taking payment, we identify the seller and confirm the product, price, delivery scope and applicable order terms. Features described on this website may be in preparation; a description of a feature does not mean it is available to use.

2. Your account

Give us accurate contact details and keep them current. Use an email address you control, protect your login and tell us if you suspect unauthorised access. To place an order, you must be legally able to enter the agreement and authorised to act for any business you represent.

Manufacturer registration is an application for review, not automatic approval, certification or access to another customer's information.

3. Acceptable use

Do not use the website to submit fraudulent requests, impersonate someone, upload unlawful material, infringe another person's rights, attempt to access private records or interfere with the service. Only send drawings, photographs, links and other material you are entitled to share.

We may restrict activity that threatens the website or other users. Any restriction must be proportionate to the issue and does not remove our responsibilities for an existing order.

4. Product information & AI

Listings may draw on supplier information, reference documents and AI-assisted drafting. Illustrations or generated images are not inspection photographs or proof of a product's condition. Where an image is illustrative, it should be labelled accordingly. Ask us about any unclear specification before ordering.

FI research notes and rankings describe the checks and evidence stated with them. Customer star ratings are separate reviews of actual purchases. They are not building approvals or independent product certification. Project-specific engineering, installation and regulatory requirements need the appropriate qualified assessment. This does not remove our responsibility for the descriptions and representations we make.

5. Quotes & pricing

For the warehouse order service, we confirm the supplier variant, quantity, availability, delivery address and quote validity before payment. A request for a quote is free of any commitment to buy unless a separate paid service has first been agreed.

The amount presented for payment is in Australian dollars (AUD). Your approved total includes the source price converted to AUD, FI's 10% markup on that source price, and the agreed freight, inspection, duties, applicable taxes and payment-cost allowance for the stated delivery scope. These costs are combined into one inclusive total. A supplier's advertised price is not a delivered FI quote.

If your requirements change or a quote expires, we confirm a replacement quote before you commit. We do not add an unapproved charge or substitute a different product after you pay.

6. Orders & payments

Check your product selection, delivery details and total before paying. Payment is available only where checkout has been activated. The warehouse order service uses Stripe-hosted checkout when enabled; some separately identified shop listings may use another hosted checkout. The seller and terms shown for the particular order must be clear before payment.

FI stores payment references and order status, not your full card number or security code. A checkout return page is not, by itself, a receipt. We verify payment with the provider before releasing an order for supplier purchasing.

A product order does not authorise recurring charges. If an agreed product cannot be supplied, we contact you about an acceptable alternative or the refund due; we do not automatically purchase a replacement without agreement.

7. Warehouse inspection & delivery

For a warehouse order, the supplier sends the product to FI's receiving warehouse first. We check the agreed product, dimensions, finish, function and packaging, record the result, and dispatch to you only after the order passes inspection. A failed check puts dispatch on hold while the issue is resolved.

Inspection reduces the risk of defects. It cannot detect every hidden defect and is not a guarantee of a 100% defect-free product. It does not replace any applicable consumer guarantee.

The quote sets out the delivery destination and scope. Dates are estimates unless expressly agreed otherwise. We will communicate material delays and discuss available options. Contact us promptly if your address changes or a parcel is missing or damaged, so we can investigate with the carrier.

8. Cancellations, faults & returns

Email your order reference and a description of the problem to the FI team. Photos can help us assess it, but missing photos or original packaging do not automatically remove a right to a remedy. Contact FI first for return instructions; do not send goods to the supplier address from a source link.

Where the Australian Consumer Law applies, a major product failure generally lets you choose a refund or replacement. For a minor failure, the business normally has an opportunity to fix the problem within a reasonable time. Other remedies may apply, including compensation for reasonably foreseeable loss. See the ACCC's repair, replacement and refund guidance.

Reasonable return costs for confirmed faulty goods are handled in line with applicable law. We do not impose a blanket "no refunds" rule or an arbitrary reporting deadline that removes statutory rights.

If you change your mind or want to cancel, contact us before procurement if possible. Any voluntary cancellation or change-of-mind arrangements, including any agreed costs for custom work, must be explained before you buy. They cannot reduce a remedy you are legally entitled to.

9. Privacy & your information

Our privacy notice explains the information we collect, why we use it, service providers, access controls and how to request access, correction or deletion. Order information may include your contact and delivery details, product choices, payment references and shipping records.

For warehouse orders, supplier instructions use the FI receiving address. Delivery details are shared with the warehouse and carrier as needed to get the order to you. Do not put passwords or payment-card details into contact forms or uploaded files.

10. Content & ownership

You keep your rights in the material you submit. You allow FI and the providers needed to carry out your request to store, review and share it for that purpose. Submitting a private drawing does not give us permission to publish it as advertising.

Website designs, text, photographs and supplier materials remain subject to their owners' rights. A source link or an AI-assisted edit does not establish permission to reuse a photograph, trademark or design. To report a suspected infringement, send us the page address, a description of the material and your contact details.

11. Third-party services

We use external services to host the website, operate accounts, process payments and arrange delivery. Links to supplier pages help identify a source; they do not make you responsible for buying from that supplier when you place a warehouse order with FI.

External websites have their own terms and privacy practices. Using a supplier, payment provider or carrier does not remove FI's own obligations for the service or product it supplies.

12. Your rights & our responsibility

Australian consumer protections apply where required by law, including guarantees about product quality, descriptions and services. These terms do not exclude those protections or any other liability that cannot lawfully be excluded. More information is available in the ACCC's consumer guarantees guide.

Website availability can be interrupted for maintenance or faults. If a website issue affects an existing order, contact us so that it can be handled directly. Pilot status and the use of AI do not excuse misleading information or remove legal responsibilities.

13. Account closure & disputes

You can stop using the website or ask us to close your account. We may restrict access to address fraud, security incidents or serious misuse, explaining the reason when it is reasonable and safe to do so. Closure does not cancel an outstanding order, erase a refund entitlement or require deletion of records that must legally be kept.

If something goes wrong, contact us with the relevant order or request reference and the outcome you are seeking. We will review the issue and respond. You remain free to seek help from your consumer protection authority or an appropriate court or tribunal. These terms do not force you into private arbitration or waive your legal rights.

14. Changes & contact

We may update this page as the service develops and will identify the update date. Material changes will be brought to users' attention through an appropriate notice. An update does not retrospectively change an accepted order without agreement or override applicable law. Keep a copy of the terms and quote supplied with your order.

Questions about these terms, a return or your information can be sent to fabricationintelligence@gmail.com, or through our contact page.

Customer reviews

Reviews require the reviewer’s own real paid FI order, recorded as delivered. Customers consent to publish their display name and review text. Account, order, address and payment details are not published. Genuine positive and negative experiences receive equal treatment. Customers may edit their own review; FI does not rewrite it. Read the review policy for prohibited content and reporting concerns.
